They set off with 1,000 ships holding 50,000 Greeks to Troy.

2026-11-26.title: Battle of Britain

2026-11-26.title: Rescue Dawn
2026-11-26.overview: A US Fighter pilot's epic struggle of survival after being shot down on a mission over Laos during the Vietnam War.

As she reclaims God's diminished kingdom, this courageous young woman has various amazing victories until her violent and untimely death.
